faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about setting up digital QR menus for your restaurant.
faq.q1: Do customers need to download an app?
faq.a1: No! Customers simply open their smartphone camera, scan the QR code, and your web menu opens instantly in their browser.
faq.q2: Can I update menu items and prices in real-time?
faq.a2: Yes, absolutely! Any change you make in your dashboard is instantly visible to customers when they scan or refresh.
faq.q3: Does MenuPro support Arabic and English languages?
faq.a3: Yes, full bilingual support for Arabic and English with automated RTL/LTR layout adjustment is built right in.
faq.q4: How do I print the QR codes for my tables?
faq.a4: You can generate high-quality printable PDF and PNG QR codes with table numbers directly from your dashboard.
